example.title: James and Margaret Greer farmstead, house, 6315 202nd

brief: Well-kept one-and-a-half-storey Craftsman bungalow in tan lap siding with window frames and doors picked out in barn red, under a broad side-gable roof of brown asphalt shingle with deep eaves and exposed rafter tails. A wide hip-roofed dormer with a ribbon of small windows faces the front, and a gabled entry porch sits off-centre on square columns rising from stone piers, reached by concrete steps; a glazed red front door with sidelights. Paired windows, a basement with small windows, foundation shrubs and a few small flags along the walk; big shade trees and a mown lawn surround it off a gravel lane.
